en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four panels showing a rural town in a hilly landscape. The upper left image is a panoramic view of a valley town labeled "Sohland / Spree." The upper right image shows a central area with houses, trees, and a church near a civic building labeled "Am Rathaus" (at the town hall). The lower left image shows a school building on a slope above scattered houses and fields, labeled "Schule am Frühlingsberg." The lower right image focuses on a large traditional building with dormer windows and a tiled roof, labeled "Volkshaus," with people gathered outside. The edges of the card are scalloped, typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards.
